# Third-party notices

This folder bundles the Google MediaPipe Tasks Vision Web runtime (version 1.2.0) and the BlazePose GHUM Pose Landmarker Lite model for local inference.

- Runtime source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision
- Official Web guide: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker/web_js
- Pose model card: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20BlazePose%20GHUM%203D.pdf
- Runtime and model license: Apache License 2.0; the runtime license text is in `LICENSE`.

The model card describes the pose model as intended for single-person pose estimation and says multiple people in an image are out of scope. This demo's pose count is experimental and must not be treated as classroom-wide attendance or a reliable group measurement.
